# A bill whose payment names the `Expenses:Supplies:USD` split of a
# transaction the book already holds.
#
# `txn_split_guid:` names that split. It moves to
# `Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD` and settles the bill. `account:` names
# `Assets:Due From Director USD`, where the money came from; the transaction
# has no bank split.
#
# Posting the bill books the cost a second time — `DR Expenses / CR A/P` — so
# the `Expenses:Supplies:USD` split is a second copy of the bill's own line.
# Moving it leaves the cost booked once.
#
# What this fixture produces: `Expenses:Supplies:USD` holding 100.00 once,
# the payable settled to nil, and `Assets:Due From Director USD` at −100.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-DIRECTOR-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-01
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-01
    due: 2026-03-01
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-DIRECTOR-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-10
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Due From Director USD"
    txn_guid: "aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900"
    txn_split_guid: "bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900aa11"
